latency_note: latency_p50_ms/p95_ms are report-timestamp minus producer_ts_ms. processing_latency_* is stage2 receive time minus producer_ts_ms and is the number that moves with load.

diversity.why: Diversity is a non-linear per-zone statistic: a zone is diverse only when its own drop-off set has at least 10 zones. Event sampling keeps a fraction of trips, so those sets stay incomplete and the fraction is biased down. Entity sampling keeps every trip for a deterministic subset of pickup zones, so the zones it keeps are fully observed. With the same sample rate the event budgets match, and the entity estimate is the one that stays close to the exact fraction.

repartition.reason: Each pickup zone's trips arrived on one partition, so its destination set was already complete.
